rows.name:
If you have two Blades, make sure to
switch between them. It'll give you a
lot more options in battle!

Have you ever seen a unique monster?
Apparently, each one has something
like an epithet.

I have. They're rumored to be crazy
strong, so I ran for my life!
See anything?

Monsters don't come near the camp,
so we should be safe here.

We're here in pursuit of
Heaven's Holy Grail. Be ready
for combat at all times.
Understood.

Our orders are to stand by here in
Gula. We could be deployed at any
moment, so stay prepared.
Understood.

We'll prepare to set sail
at a moment's notice.

Another dead end!
How are we supposed to find the exact
location of Heaven's Holy Grail?!

We can't move this Divine Beast
warship recklessly. Our only option is
to wait for word from the homeland.
We should head for Iira at once!

Even so, we haven't received orders.
We could be mistaken for invaders
taking advantage of the chaos.

We're finally departing for Iira. It's
time to show them the might of the
Superbian army!

We're still preparing for departure.
Please calm yourself, sir, or your
blood pressure...

Capture the remnants of Shiya if you
can. And recover their equipment...

Understood, but few of them are
surrendering. It's proving to be a
struggle.

Yuugo-sama! Thank goodness
you're safe.

When we heard that the Iiran capital,
Aurium, was attacked by Heaven's
Holy Grail, we feared the worst.

Yuugo-sama.
We're about to set sail with this
Divine Beast battleship for Iira.

The battle against Heaven's Holy
Grail will be fierce... We swear
that we will prove useful to you.
